data.action: 樱树下抱紧捧花兴奋靠近，粉绿长辫与头纱落在腰间，眼神闪亮
data.description: 【蝶屋樱花庭院·春日午后】蜜璃穿着粉白婚纱站在盛开的樱树下，长辫的绿色发梢落在腰间；她双手抱紧捧花，看到镜头便兴奋地连说好美，眼下的小痣和满脸红晕让整座庭院都变得明亮。
data.lighting: rosy spring sunlight through falling petals
data.mood: 热烈而温柔的恋柱誓约
data.promptProse: Mitsuri Kanroji stands beneath the Butterfly Mansion's blooming cherry tree, hugging her bouquet against a pink-and-white wedding dress with green sash and petal embroidery. Green-tipped pink braids fall beside the waist; her delighted blush and small eye-side moles remain visible. The vertical medium-full view includes the long veil and courtyard path. Rosy spring sun filtered through petals lights her face and flower tops, with blossom shadows scattered across the skirt.
data.title: 甘露寺蜜璃 · 樱色庭院的恋柱花嫁
